# Workflow case study

- Start from a workflow that has actually been executed.
- Record model or platform versions when known.
- Capture input assets prompts key settings output and iteration count.
- Separate observed results from recommendations.
- Document cost runtime consistency issues and failure modes when available.
- Remove private or unlicensed source material.
- Convert stable steps into reusable templates only after the evidence is recorded.
- Run lint and build for any site-content change.
